none: PAS NLM-EFCF13: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian from Keelby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Securitas Rei Publicae issue, Reece period 19; chipped with loss of circa 40% of area. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Mintmarks: In field OF I; in exergue: ?OM? Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 1.56gms, die axis: 6
